rows.grounds: compound: daśa-sīmā-avasāna+kam (having an end at the boundary of ten)

items.question: What count and terminal boundary are specified from this point onward?
premises: The enumeration proceeds upward from this point.
The sequence terminates at the boundary of ten.
items.inference: From this point onward the enumeration reaches thirty-four and ends at the limit of ten.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the count and the sense of the ten-limit boundary depend on the broader ritual context.
items.plain_english: From here upward, there are thirty-four, ending at the limit of ten.
